touch-a-saved-choice.title: Search and edit a saved choice on a phone
touch-a-saved-choice.start: Open the package gallery with A Coruña saved.

steps.action: Tap the text near its left edge, type Por Norte, then tap near the first word boundary and type t.
steps.expect: The first tap opens the options. The edit appears at the caret in the query and the saved destination is still A Coruña.

steps.action: Dismiss the search, tap the center of the field, type Athens and tap Αθήνα.
steps.expect: The new query replaces the saved label, and choosing the Greek result commits the destination.

choose-and-preview.title: Preview a destination and commit it with the keyboard
choose-and-preview.start: Open the package gallery with A Coruña saved in a synthetic trip.

steps.action: Type Oprto, use the down arrow and press Alt+Enter.
steps.expect: Porto is announced as the active option. Its preview appears while A Coruña stays saved.
The picker closes, focus stays in the field and the saved destination is Porto.

recover-a-search.title: Recover an empty search and choose in another language
recover-a-search.start: Open the package gallery with A Coruña saved in a synthetic trip.

steps.action: Type nothinggg and press Down, Enter, Alt+Enter and Up.
steps.expect: The list reports no matches. The typed query and the original saved destination stay in place.

steps.action: Clear the query, press Escape and type xyz. Dismiss the second search, reopen by pointer and choose Porto. Restore the original destination, type Poto, move left twice and insert r.
steps.expect: Typing after Escape starts a fresh search. A pointer chooses Porto. Editing in the middle of a new query produces Porto while A Coruña stays saved.

steps.action: Browse the Porto results and leave with Tab. Try another search, click outside, then search for Athens and choose Αθήνα.
steps.expect: Tab and the outside click keep A Coruña. Choosing the Greek result saves Αθήνα.
